name: What types of hardware are commonly adjusted?

mainEntity.name: What types of hardware are commonly adjusted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commonly adjusted hardware includes door hinges, latches, and closers; window sashes, locks, and balances; cabinet hinges, drawer slides, and pulls; and various plumbing and electrical fixtures. The specific hardware depends on the building's design and chosen materials. Even small details like towel bars or curtain rod mounts might require adjustments for optimal use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commonly adjusted hardware includes door and window components, cabinet hinges, drawer slides, and various plumbing and electrical fixtures.
